description:
Bible sales are soaring. Christian Faith Defender Wesley Huff on why the West is rediscovering Jesus.
Wesley Huff is a PhD candidate and leading Christian apologist specialising in the historical accuracy of ancient Biblical texts. He serves as the Vice President of Apologetics Canada and is the host of a YouTube channel dedicated to the science of faith.
He explains:
Why Christianity and interest in the Bible are rising again
Why New Atheism may have left a generation in a meaning crisis
How to think about suffering if God is loving
Why humans seem wired to worship something
How faith and evidence can be explored together
00:00 Intro
02:21 Why Religious Belief Is Suddenly Surging Again
06:25 The Hidden Debate: Atheism vs. Faith Movement
08:33 Why Humans Aren’t Meant to Live Alone 
15:09 Is the Bible Historically Credible?
20:02 The Biggest Misunderstandings People Have About the Bible
31:16 Who Actually Witnessed the Resurrection 
35:58 Were the Stories of Jesus Invented? 
41:37 If God Exists, Why Does Suffering Exist? 
01:01:10 Why Evolution Alone May Not Answer the Biggest Questions About Our Origins
01:11:24 Is Heaven the Point of the Bible - Or Is It Something Else Entirely?
01:12:58 Do Animals Have Souls?
01:18:31 If You Sin, Are You Automatically Going to Hell?
01:38:55 Does Your Religion Depend on Where You Were Born? 
01:41:12 Does Prayer Actually Work?
01:44:26 Religion vs. A.I. - Could Technology Challenge Faith?
01:52:31 Why Young People Around the World Are Facing a Crisis of Meaning
01:59:30 A Message for Anyone Feeling Lost or Without Purpose
02:05:41 Why Questioning Christianity Has Changed in the Last Decade
02:07:01 How A.I. Could Transform the Future of Religion
02:12:18 From Paralyzed Child to Apologist 
02:16:36 The Supernatural - Can People Really Speak to the Dead?
